project.title: EBV proteomics data -  Identification of Epstein-Barr Virus Replication Proteins in Burkitt's Lymphoma Cells
project.projectDescription: A SILAC based experiment of cells infected or uninfected with EBV
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: SILAC labelled cells with or without virus, total protein extracts taken, mixed and run on a gel, 6 slices taken and analysed byn MS/MS on an Oribitrap Velos at the University of Bristol
project.dataProcessingProtocol: RAW files processed by MAxQuant using a standard list of human and EBV proteins as the search space.
